subject: Delta overage appeal and staged capacity addendum
messages:
From: Zira Patel <zira@shopsense.ai>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@shopsense.ai
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: emergency uplift + request to waive delta surcharge for launch spike

Sean —

Quick note from launch week: we’re seeing a brief but sharp spike in inference volume tied to a new campaign (about 3x our committed QPS for ~36 hours). Our engineers are throttling to avoid customer-visible errors, but it’s hurting conversions.

We reviewed the standard overrun terms and the "delta surcharge" line items—ShopSense is asking for a partial waiver of the surge surcharge for the initial 72 hours because this is a one-off marketing-driven spike tied to a co-marketing campaign with Appleton Retail. We can accept a staged uplift agreement but need a cap so this doesn’t blow our financial runway.

Request:
- Temporary increase to the rate limit to support peak for 3 days (May 23–25)
- Partial surcharge waiver: request 70% reduction on delta surcharge for the first 72 hours, then revert to standard overrun terms
- Rapid turnaround on contract addendum and a billing path so procurement can issue a PO this week

I’ve attached a compact usage snapshot (shopsense-usage-weekly.csv) and can loop in finance if helpful. Thanks — appreciate anything you can do to keep the launch smooth.

—Zira
Head of Product
ShopSense

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Zira Patel <zira@shopsense.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, procurement@shopsense.ai
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: emergency uplift + request to waive delta surcharge for launch spike

Hi Zira —

Thanks for the heads-up and congrats on the campaign — sounds like a great lift. We can support a temporary limit increase but need to align on the commercial path quickly. High level proposal from my side:

- Immediate: open a temporary throughput lane capped to 3.5x committed QPS for 72 hours (May 23 09:00 PDT → May 26 09:00 PDT).
- Commercial: offer a staged capacity addendum (attached draft) that: 
  • applies a 50% reduction to the delta surcharge for the first 72 hours
  • applies a 25% reduction for any sustained uplift in the following billing week (if you need it)
  • caps total surcharge exposure at a predetermined dollar ceiling you approve in writing
- Logistics: procurement signs the addendum + PO; legal countersigned via DocuSign (I’ll share the link).

I’m looping in Laura (pricing and billing) and Karthik (solutions/throughput engineering) to lock the numbers and the operational routing. Laura, can you confirm the surcharge bands and a suggested dollar cap options we should offer? Karthik, can your team confirm we can route traffic without introducing queuing for the rest of the tenant?

I attached a quick draft: capacity-addendum-draft-v1.pdf — feel free to redline and I’ll fast-track. If procurement can send a PO this week we’ll set the lane live as soon as legal has the signed addendum.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, Zira Patel <zira@shopsense.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, procurement@shopsense.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: emergency uplift + request to waive delta surcharge for launch spike

Zira / team —

Thanks for the context. I reviewed the usage snapshot and modeled three options; summarizing here so procurement can pick a lane quickly:

Option A (Conservative cap):
- Temporary uplift to 3.5x for 72 hours
- Delta surcharge for tokens above commit: $0.10/token; 50% reduction applied for first 72 hours → effective $0.05/token for that window
- Dollar cap options: $25k / $50k / $75k (you choose) — once cap hit, calls will throttle back to committed QPS or we’ll engage emergency PO top-up

Option B (Balanced):
- Same uplift window
- Delta surcharge $0.08/token; 60% reduction first 72 hours → effective $0.032/token
- Cap options: $75k / $100k

Option C (Expedite accept):
- One-time full waiver on transaction fees for the first 36 hours with a contingency cap of $20k; then revert to baseline $0.10/token

Notes: 
- We can prorate charges to the second and produce an interim invoice for the surge period to help you manage cash flow.
- Attached is a pricing matrix (pricing-matrix-v2.xlsx) and the addendum draft updated with Option B language (redlined).

If you want the 70% reduction you requested, Option B with an explicit $75k cap would be the closest match (ends up ~65–70% depending on token mix). Once you confirm which dollar cap to set, I’ll issue a final addendum and route to DocuSign.

Laura Bennett
Head of Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Zira Patel <zira@shopsense.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@shopsense.ai
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 16:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: emergency uplift + request to waive delta surcharge for launch spike

Laura / Sean —

Appreciate the fast modeling. We’ll take Option B with the $75k cap — that gives us runway and aligns with our finance guardrails. Two quick asks before procurement signs:

1) Please include an explicit clause that any usage above the cap will require prior written PO to reactivate the uplifts (so we don’t get surprised bills).
2) Can you send an interim invoice/statement for the surge window within 5 business days after the uplift ends? Our AP team wants a line item they can schedule against.

Once those two calls are in the addendum, we’ll have procurement sign the DocuSign link you shared. I’ll coordinate PO issuance today.

Thanks again — this should keep conversions from dropping during the campaign.

—Zira
Head of Product, ShopSense
